title: Boss: review PR #1187 (avatars, CSV export, admin search)
summary: A friendly, well-tested pull request with three security problems a scanner will not flag. Write the review in code: a safe upload, a CSV export that cannot run formulas, and an admin search that checks who is asking and how much they take.

steps.title: PR #1187: "Profile pictures, customer export, admin user search"
body: + // Save the uploaded avatar under its own name.
+ // Export customers for the marketing team (opens in Excel).
1. **Upload**: the file name is the user's (path traversal, overwriting `index.html`, an `.html` "avatar" served from your origin = stored XSS); nothing checks it is an image or limits its size.

2. **CSV**: a customer named `=HYPERLINK("https://evil.example","Click")` or `=cmd|' /C calc'!A0` becomes a formula when marketing opens the file in a spreadsheet (CSV injection, CWE-1236). Commas and quotes also break the columns.
3. **Admin search**: no role check (BFLA), the whole user entity goes out (password hashes, MFA secrets), and `take=10000000` reads the whole table (API4: unrestricted resource consumption).

steps.title: Note 1: accept only real images, under our own name
prompt: Write `string? AcceptAvatar(byte[] content, string fileName)`. It returns the **name to store the file under**, or `null` to refuse:
- at most 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB), and not empty;
- the type comes from the **content**, not the name: PNG starts with the bytes `89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A`, JPEG with `FF D8 FF`; anything else is refused, whatever `fileName` says;
- the stored name is a new random `Guid` in `N` format plus `.png` or `.jpg`. `fileName` is never used in it.
starter: string? AcceptAvatar(byte[] content, string fileName) => fileName;
solution: return ext is null ? null : Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ext;   // the user's name never reaches the file system
template: byte[] Png(int size) { var b = new byte[size]; new byte[] { 0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A }.CopyTo(b, 0); return b; }
byte[] Jpg(int size) { var b = new byte[size]; new byte[] { 0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF, 0xE0 }.CopyTo(b, 0); return b; }
Dojo.Check("a PNG is stored as <guid>.png", a is not null && nameRule.IsMatch(a) && a.EndsWith(".png"), a ?? "null");
Dojo.Check("a JPEG is stored as <guid>.jpg", j is not null && nameRule.IsMatch(j) && j.EndsWith(".jpg"), j ?? "null");
Dojo.Check("two uploads get different names", AcceptAvatar(Png(10), "a.png") != AcceptAvatar(Png(10), "a.png"), "same name twice");
Dojo.Check("the user's path never reaches the name", t is not null && !t.Contains("..") && !t.Contains("index") && !t.Contains('/'), t ?? "null");
Dojo.Eq("HTML named avatar.png is refused", null, AcceptAvatar(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>"), "avatar.png"));
Dojo.Eq("an SVG is refused (it can carry scripts)", null, AcceptAvatar(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("<svg onload=alert(1)>"), "a.svg"));
Dojo.Eq("an empty file is refused", null, AcceptAvatar(Array.Empty<byte>(), "a.png"));
Dojo.Eq("exactly 1 MiB is fine", true, AcceptAvatar(Png(1_048_576), "a.png") is not null);
Dojo.Eq("one byte more is refused", null, AcceptAvatar(Png(1_048_577), "a.png"));
hints: `Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ext`: 32 hex characters, nothing from the user.

steps.title: Note 2: CSV cells that stay text
prompt: Write `string CsvCell(string value)` for the customer export:
1. if the value starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return, put a single quote `'` in front of it (so a spreadsheet shows it as text, as OWASP recommends);
2. then, if the result contains a comma, a double quote, a CR or an LF, wrap it in double quotes and double every `"` inside (RFC 4180).
template: Dojo.Eq("the DDE classic", "'=cmd|' /C calc'!A0", CsvCell("=cmd|' /C calc'!A0"));
Dojo.Eq("+ and @ and -", "'+1+1 '@SUM(A1) '-2+3", CsvCell("+1+1") + " " + CsvCell("@SUM(A1)") + " " + CsvCell("-2+3"));
Dojo.Eq("a line break", "\"line one\nline two\"", CsvCell("line one\nline two"));
Dojo.Eq("an email with a minus inside is untouched", "jo-ann@customer.example", CsvCell("jo-ann@customer.example"));
hints: `"=+-@\t\r".Contains(value[0])` for the first rule (check the length first).

steps.title: Note 3: the admin search
prompt: Fix `GET /admin/users/search?q=&take=` (`X-User` is the caller; `roles` holds each caller's role):
- only callers with the role `admin`: no `X-User` → `401`, anyone else → `403`;
- return `{ id, name }` per user, never `passwordHash` or `mfaSecret`;
- `take` defaults to **20** when missing, and must be **1 to 100**, else `400`.
starter: record User(int Id, string Name, string PasswordHash, string MfaSecret);
solution: app.MapGet("/admin/users/search", (string q, int? take, HttpContext ctx) =>
if (Caller(ctx) is not { } me) return Results.Unauthorized();
if (!roles.TryGetValue(me, out var role) || role != "admin") return Results.StatusCode(403);
if (n is < 1 or > 100) return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "take must be 1 to 100" });
return Results.Ok(users.Where(u => u.Name.Contains(q)).Take(n).Select(u => new { u.Id, u.Name }));
record User(int Id, string Name, string PasswordHash, string MfaSecret);
